integrity: A direct all-rank component-game induction and an all-rank strict-chain induction prove the results. A finite exhaustive checker corroborates only the strict-chain specialization through ten vertices; no independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The component composition theorem assumes finite hosts of a hereditary base class with one singleton type, independently assembled using a named equivalence relation. The sharp numerical classification concerns finite disjoint-chain strict posets and natural-number one-point-extension ranks, not arbitrary posets or infinite hosts. Historical priority is provisional because two closely indexed full texts were inaccessible.
title: A component-rank staircase theorem and sharp kernels for finite unions of chains
